baseline.observed: No global limit on jobs, no preflight auth check, and missing live job UI on add device.
baseline.what_exists: Unbounded concurrent jobs allowed. Add device modal closes instantly.

report.objective: Implement Max-5 concurrency limit for Inventory jobs, Preflight Auth check, and a live progress UI during device addition.
requirements: Add backend logic to throttle INVENTORY_COLLECT jobs to 5 concurrent executions globally.
Introduce a PREFLIGHT (Auth-check) job that verifies credentials (fast fail) before INVENTORY_COLLECT is allowed.
Modify AddDeviceDialog.tsx so it stays open and displays live progress logs of the PREFLIGHT and INVENTORY jobs.
validation_plan: Run Java tests, test frontend UI components.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Backend synchronization and advanced UI state management.
